svg.title: ClaimAuditor LangGraph flow
svg.desc: Flowchart showing the full LangGraph node sequence from input through decomposer, parallel advocate and skeptic, arbitrator, a conditional loop back, and finally reporter or escalation output.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the start node do in ClaimAuditor?')
sendPrompt('What does the decomposer agent do?')
sendPrompt('What does the advocate agent do?')
sendPrompt('What does the skeptic agent do?')
sendPrompt('What does the arbitrator agent do?')
sendPrompt('What does the reporter node produce?')
